IN pursuance of the provisions of clause (3) of Article 348 of the Constitution of India, the
Governor is pleased to order the publication of the following English translation of notification no. 750/IX-
1–2022-30T.A.-22, dated July 14, 2022:
No. 750/IX-1–2022-30T.A.-22
Dated Lucknow, July 14, 2022
THE following draft notification which the Governor proposes to issue in exercise of the powers
under clause (2) of Article 243-Q of the Constitution of India read with sub-section (2) of section 3 of the
Uttar Pradesh Municipalities Act, 1916 (U.P. Act no. 2 of 1916) and in partial modification of notification
no. 3655/9-1-T/64 dated, September 6, 1972 and other previous notifications issued in this behalf,
including the areas specified in the Schedule below in the transitional area of Nagar Panchayat Dibiyapur
in District Auraiya, is hereby published for the information of all concerned and with a view to invite
objections and suggestions in respect thereof as required under sub-section (1) of section 4 of the aforesaid
Act.
2. Objections or suggestions, if any, with respect to the proposed notification should be sent in
writing addressed to the Principal Secretary, Nagar Vikas Anubhag-1, Uttar Pradesh Shasan, Bapu
Bhawan, Lucknow. Only such objections and suggestions shall be taken into consideration as are received
within fifteen days from the date of publication of this notification in the Gazette.
Draft Notification
IN exercise of the powers under clause (2) of Article 243-Q of the Constitution of India read
with sub-section (2) of Section 3 of the Uttar Pradesh Municipalities Act, 1916 (U.P. Act no. 2 of 1916),
and in partial modification of notification no. 3655/9-1-T/64, dated September 6, 1972 and other previous
notifications issued in this behalf, the Governor having regard to the population of the area, the density of
the population therein, the revenue generated for local administration, the percentage of employment in
non–agricultural activities and the economic importance, is pleased to include the areas specified in the
Schedule below in the transitional area of Nagar Panchayat Dibiyapur in District Auraiya for the purposes
of Part IX-A of the Constitution of India.
